regime_hint: sustained workplace restrictions or remote work adoption
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the mean over the last 28 days, or WORKPLACES recovers by more than 15 percentage points within the first two weeks of the forecast window.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 15 percentage points while GROCERY_PHARM remains below -10%, indicating decoupling of essential and discretionary spending.
